⚖️ Realm Market Exchange Pathfinder 2e Item Prices

"One Price Board for All Your Adventuring Needs"

The Exchange's tally-clerks post new prices every 15 minutes, and every traveler reads the same board: 1,300 goods from the Pathfinder core books, each with its item level. Prices drift within 15% of the book price.
